decisions.reason: The black-finish range is a cheap finish variant of the core offer that follows bathroom design trends, so its results likely meet aspirations and give no reason to search for other uses of its resources.
The seamless-covering shower channel is central to the barrier-free bathroom strategy and still has its own page, so it likely meets aspirations at little cost.

The newer pump-drain shower channel F may overlap with this pump-assisted line, which raises the risk of consolidation, but slack and demand from renovation projects still allow it to be carried for now.
Launched in 2024 with its own page, the pump-drain channel is too new to judge against aspirations and fits the firm's innovation push in renovation drainage.
